verdict.rationale: The product lets you create API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials and set their permissions and an optional expiry date. Endpoint references list named permissions (e.g., "Monitor and unmonitor customers", "View roles in account"), so credentials can be scoped down to specific operations for an agent. Missing for 10: a documented full catalogue of credential permission scopes and how they map to endpoints, programmatic/API-based credential issuance or rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
